method.path: Isolated qualification routers with real API-key authorization, atomic RPM/TPM reservation, public SSE framing, and production usage/billing settlement.
method.prompts: Unique text; approximately 45 or 750 tokens, 25 percent long prompts; 256 output tokens; temperature 0; thinking disabled.
method.native_decode_rate: (final completion tokens - first completion tokens) / (final native inference time - first native inference time)
method.client_decode_rate: (completion tokens - 1) / (last visible token time - first visible token time); buffering can increase this estimate.
method.scope: Warm traffic. Explicit warmup requests retained separately. Cold GPU allocation, cache-miss authorization and untested long prompts are outside the warm SLO.
